def_en: 1) Jacob's and Rachel's youngest son, Joseph's full brother
2) son of Bilhan, great-grandson of Benjamin
3) a Benjamite, one of the sons of Harim, in the time of Ezra who had taken a strange wife
4) the tribe descended from Benjamin, the son of Jacob
expl: Binjamin, youngest son of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory
etim: from and ; son of (the) right hand;
